prompt: Use case: illustration-story, production game map. Create a very clear LARGE 3:2 landscape oblique aerial map of ONE coherent small German town for a language learning app used by fourteen year olds. It will be shown through a moving cropped camera, so the whole artwork must form a continuous navigable landscape with no border or labels. Three main destinations with precise geography: at 27% across and 58% down a small ochre bakery with distinctive red-and-cream striped awning, bread in display window, low terracotta roof; at 73% across and 61% down an open park with birch trees, a pond, gravel curved path, one ordinary wooden bench, picnic table and grass; at 63% across and 24% down a cream-and-ochre German school with long rectangular facade, tall regular windows, red tiled roof and clear front entrance. Connect all three destinations with broad legible pale stone streets. Some low village houses on upper left and edges, but leave generous open ground around the three destinations and do not obscure them with foreground trees. Human-scaled believable architecture, consistent perspective and coherent shadows. Restrained warm watercolor / gouache animation background with precise pencil outlines, matte surfaces, visible paper texture and broad composed foliage masses; mature, calm and crisp rather than cute or childish. Muted sage and olive greens, warm cream, dusty terracotta, soft blue water. High clarity at desktop size, distinct silhouettes and clean recognizable structures. Do not fill every space with repetitive flowers or decorative objects. No people, no character, no castle, no magical glow, no English or German lettering, no text, no UI, no map pins, no watermarks. Deliberate professional environment illustration.

Keep the sixth cell (bottom right) completely EMPTY transparent. Same girl: chestnut-brown shoulder-length hair, short side ponytail on viewer right, pink bow, amber eyes, white short-sleeve blouse, pink necktie, slight blue skirt visible. Preserve the SAME character identity and linework from the reference; age-appropriate clothing and proportions. All portraits exactly match framing, head size, face angle and eye-line. Top left: existing friendly wink and small open-handed wave. Top middle: existing gently surprised discovery, eyes open wider and mouth small O. Top right: existing proud/relieved smile, hands softly clasped. Bottom left: NEW thoughtful curious expression, eyes looking a little upward, index finger resting at chin, relaxed eyebrows, mouth closed. Bottom middle: NEW focused thinking expression, gaze slightly downward, eyebrows subtly drawn together, one hand lightly at cheek, no angry or sad look. Precise clean anime linework and cel coloring matching reference. Characters wholly inside their own cells, safe transparent margins, white blouse remains opaque. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background with alpha zero outside characters and in the entire sixth cell; no colored backdrop, no white panel, no checkerboard drawing, no grid lines, no captions. A production sprite sheet, not a poster.

Use case: identity-preserve 2-frame blink sprite. Use the supplied Mia reference atlas, specifically its top-left relaxed smiling character. Create ONE transparent image with exactly TWO equal portrait cells side by side. Each portrait is waist-up, individual frame 2:3 aspect ratio, overall image 4:3 landscape. SAME front-facing character in SAME relaxed neutral pose and SAME face and body geometry in both frames: chestnut brown short side ponytail to viewer right with pink bow, amber eyes, white short-sleeve blouse with pink trim and pink necktie. FIRST frame: eyes comfortably open, gentle closed-mouth smile. SECOND frame: EXACTLY the same portrait but both eyelids gently closed during a natural blink, eyebrows, mouth, hair, shoulders, hands and clothing completely unchanged. It is NOT a happy squint or wink, only a neutral blink. Both heads and torsos perfectly aligned to identical pixel positions within their frames. Leave safe transparent margins around each portrait. Keep characters opaque including white blouse; actual alpha=0 transparent outside character. No background color, no drawn checkerboard, no borders, no text, no labels, no extra portraits. The frames will switch for only 120 milliseconds and must not appear to jump.
